workstreams.scope: Reconcile CodeQL analysis identity on main versus the PR head, verify protected-merge Code scanning requirements without relaxing rulesets, and produce exact SHA/check evidence.

workstreams.scope: Enumerate real SonarCloud issue keys/severity/rules/locations, triage blockers first, write minimal regression tests for confirmed findings and measure new-code coverage.
workstreams.deliverable: Keyed Sonar issue inventory and focused test-backed remediation; report unavailable dashboard access as BLOCKED.
requires: Authorized SonarCloud issue export for complete triage

workstreams.scope: Review JSON-RPC error-envelope and metadata corrections; execute bounded protocol-negative tests and independently authenticated conformance only when staging is approved.

workstreams.scope: Review Agent Card preflight and locked-runner changes; verify schema, bounded bodies, invalid token, task lifecycle and replay with isolated test fixtures.
workstreams.deliverable: Deterministic A2A test report; separate verified staging results from source-only validations.
requires: Authorized A2A staging service and test credentials

workstreams.scope: Evaluate claim/lease deadline, receipts, revocation, termination, distro/container test matrix and least privilege. No host enrollment or command execution without authorization.

requires: Authorized Linux test host for live lifecycle checks

workstreams.area: Read-only GLR / EVM / BNB / Solana truth
